home_seo_title: NextUp QMS | Queue management for every industry
home_seo_description: NextUp is multi-tenant queue management for hospitals, banks, and SMEs. Kiosk, QR tickets, TV voice calling, appointments, SMS and WhatsApp in one console.
home_hero_headline: Turn waiting lines into a calm, called flow
home_hero_body: NextUp: multi-industry queue management with kiosk, QR tickets, TV voice calling, and appointments in one tenant console.
home_how_heading: From first ticket to the counter
home_how_lead: One flow for walk-ins and booked visits. Built for the moments people actually stand in line.
home_how_step1_body: Guests join from kiosk, QR, web, or appointment check-in. Each ticket gets a public status link.
home_how_step2_body: Live position, SLA awareness, and optional SMS or WhatsApp when they are almost next.
home_how_step3_body: Agents call, recall, hold, or transfer. TV displays and voice announce the next ticket.
home_how_step4_body: Complete, no-show, or move to another queue. Every step lands on the ticket timeline.
home_industries_lead: Industry packs seed services, voice copy, and queue strategy. Each business then tunes the floor.
home_industries_hospitals_body: Departments, triage priority, rooms as counters, appointment-first queues.
home_industries_banking_body: Teller lines, VIP weight, document desks, and calm lobby displays.
home_industries_other_body: Retail, government, telecom, and SME floors on one configurable pack.
home_model_heading: One SaaS. Many tenants. Clear roles.
home_model_lead: NextUp is multi-tenant by design. The platform creates the business. The business runs the queue. Guests never need your back office.
home_model_platform_body: Super admins seed businesses, bind industry packs, and invite owners.
home_model_business_body: Owners and managers configure sites, services, counters, queues, and devices.
home_model_floor_body: Agents call, transfer, hold, and complete tickets from the live console.
home_model_guests_body: Walk-in kiosk and QR, or signed-in guests for tickets and appointments.
home_surfaces_heading: Surfaces for every role on the floor
home_surfaces_kiosk_body: Fullscreen take-a-number for the lobby. Pair a device and open the public kiosk link.
home_surfaces_tv_body: Now serving boards with browser speech announcements and live queue counts.
home_surfaces_agent_body: Call next, recall, serve, hold, no-show, and transfer without leaving the desk.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Platform and business dashboards for sites, services, team invites, and settings.
home_omni_heading: Reach guests where they already are
home_omni_lead: Web, kiosk, display, voice, and messaging share one ticket timeline so the floor stays in sync.
home_cta_heading: Ready to line up the next guest
home_cta_body: Sign in to the platform console, open a business, and start calling from the agent desk.
home_footer_tagline: Queue management for hospitals, banks, and every kind of business counter.
pricing_seo_title: NextUp QMS pricing | Cloud and On-premise
pricing_seo_description: NextUp Soft Wash QMS: Cloud from $49/mo (Starter to Platform). On-premise uses the same tiers at Cloud price + $150/mo for install and setup on your infrastructure. Floors, kiosk, QR, and TV voice.
pricing_lead: Cloud SaaS or On-premise on your infrastructure. Same Starter, Business, Scale, and Platform tiers. Sized for floors and messaging, not per-ticket meter anxiety.
pricing_lead_cloud: Cloud is hosted Soft Wash QMS: multi-tenant SaaS, managed updates, and shared infrastructure for every floor you run.
pricing_lead_onprem: On-premise is the same product tiers, installed and set up on your servers, database, and network. You own the infrastructure. Monthly list is Cloud + ${premium} for that responsibility.
pricing_lead_mmk: Showing MMK at 1 USD = {rate} MMK for local comparison.
pricing_lead_usd: USD list prices for global teams.

pricing_who_lead: Platform, business, floor, and guests each get a clear lane. Pick Cloud or On-premise, then the same tier that matches how many floors and channels you run.
pricing_who_platform_body: Operators and MSPs who seed many businesses, bind industry packs, and need white-label plus SSO. Choose Platform on Cloud or On-premise.
pricing_who_business_body: Owners and managers configuring sites, services, counters, and devices. Business or Scale (Cloud or On-premise) fits most multi-floor chains.
pricing_who_floor_body: Agents calling, transferring, and completing tickets. Seat limits scale with the plan; guests never see the back office.
pricing_who_guests_body: Walk-in kiosk, QR tickets, appointments, and SMS or WhatsApp updates. Guest surfaces are included; messaging packs grow by tier.
pricing_faq_q1: Is pricing per ticket or per agent?
pricing_faq_a1: Published tiers are per business with floor and seat caps. Cloud and On-premise share Starter, Business, Scale, and Platform. On-premise monthly list is Cloud + $150. Neither mode uses a per-ticket meter that spikes on busy days.
pricing_faq_a2: Annual discounts of about 15 to 20% are common in queue SaaS (for example Waitwhile publishes about 20% off annual). NextUp applies 20% off the monthly list when you pay yearly, for both Cloud and On-premise (after the +$150 On-premise premium).
pricing_faq_q3: Do SMS and WhatsApp cost extra?
pricing_faq_a3: Starter focuses on in-venue flow. Business and above include messaging packs. High-volume or regulated regions may need add-on credits. On-premise messaging often uses your own providers; ask when you scope the install.
pricing_faq_a4: Use the market toggle above the plans. Global shows USD only. Myanmar shows MMK at 1 USD = 5000 MMK (with USD as a secondary line). Billing period (Monthly or Annual) and service mode (Cloud or On-premise) are separate from market.
pricing_faq_a5: Cloud is hosted Soft Wash QMS: multi-tenant SaaS, managed updates, and faster start. On-premise uses the same tiers, installed and set up on your infrastructure, database, and network when you need control or residency. Infra is yours; monthly list is Cloud + $150 for that responsibility.
